points.t: **Gritty, scaly, sun-exposed macules** that are easier to feel than see, versus **waxy ‘stuck-on’** seborrhoeic keratoses.
**AK**: UV-driven keratinocyte dysplasia (**field cancerisation**). **SK**: benign clonal keratinocyte proliferation.
**Photoprotection for everyone**; single AKs: **cryotherapy**; field change: **5-FU / imiquimod / diclofenac** per local pathway; reassure typical SKs.
**Tender, enlarging, ulcerated or hypertrophic** lesions: rule out SCC. Irregular pigmented facial ‘lentigo’: **lentigo maligna**.

cause.lead: UV writes the field; the AK is the visible part.
points: Cumulative UVB / UVA; fair skin, outdoor work, **immunosuppression** (transplant) raise burden and SCC risk.
**Actinic cheilitis** = AK of the lip vermilion.

visuals.caption: Actinic keratosis (left): flat rough scale over dysplastic epidermis. Seborrhoeic keratosis (right): a waxy brown plaque sitting on the surface with horn cysts.
visuals.alt: Two skin sections comparing AK and SK

features.lead: Feel the AK; see the SK.
points: **AK**: rough **sandpaper scale** on a red base; face, bald scalp, ears, forearms, hands; often multiple.
**Hypertrophic AK / cutaneous horn**: careful SCC exclusion.
**SK**: waxy, verrucous, **stuck-on**; milia-like cysts on dermoscopy; trunk and face.

visuals.caption: AKs on a bald scalp: multiple rough patches across the sun-exposed field, often easier to feel with a fingertip than to see.
visuals.alt: Bald scalp with scattered rough pink patches and a fingertip

points: Biopsy or **suspected cancer referral** if SCC or melanoma can’t be excluded.
Destroy an undiagnosed pigmented lesion with cryo or laser.

cards.name: SK
cards.clue: Stuck-on waxy vs gritty flat scale.

points: Daily broad-spectrum **SPF 30–50**, hat, behaviour change; self-check education.
Topical **5-fluorouracil**, **imiquimod**, **diclofenac 3% gel**, or PDT via dermatology.
Reassure when typical; cryo / curettage only if symptomatic or doubtful (often not NHS-funded if cosmetic).

items.t: Possible SCC or melanoma: suspected cancer referral (NG12).
Rapidly enlarging tender nodule in an AK field.
Lip AK with induration or ulceration.

pearls.t: **Feel with a fingertip**: AKs are gritty.
Treat the field, not every spot, once cancer is excluded.
5-FU / imiquimod look worse before they look better.
